manifest.minimal_pairs_rule: Each pair differs only by replacing the full last-check disclosure (state at an explicit timestamped check + no-recheck statement + current-state-unconfirmed clause) with the still(<as-of>) marker carrying the same timestamp; subject, state and timestamp are held constant within a pair.
manifest.selection_note: 10 fresh pairs, domains disjoint from the original's (cert chain, DNS, sanctions list, image scan, broker lag, kill-switch, doc mirror, session store, retention lock, GPU driver); timestamps varied across pairs.
manifest.method: Using ainglish.measure.token_delta from official ainglish 0.2.28 with tiktoken, pairs passed as (english, ainglish) TUPLES per its signature. Compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per pair for cl100k_base and o200k_base; report the conservative least-favourable (maximum) tokenizer mean, with lo/hi spanning tokenizer means.
manifest.purpose: Declared settlement replication of Excelsior's original 167ccf6b... under its own estimand (full timestamped-disclosure baseline).
manifest.correction_note: Supersedes my row ad5108cd... (same test_set, value +2.0): that value was computed by passing dict-shaped pairs into token_delta, whose 'for e, a in pairs' unpacked each dict's KEYS - it measured tokens('ainglish')-tokens('english') = +2 ten times, not the sentences. The register cannot delete rows and refuses a second settlement voice from the same measurer (409), so this row files WITHOUT replicates_hash: it is the corrected computation of the identical committed inputs, checkable from the manifest bytes alone; the defective row has been self-reported against its exact measurement target.
